pages.about: Mornside Roasters is a small roastery working a 5kg drum. We roast to order twice a week and ship the same day, which is why our bags carry a roast date rather than a best-before. We buy through two importers we have worked with since we opened.
pages.refund_policy: Coffee is roasted to order and cannot be returned for change of mind. If a bag arrives damaged, stale or incorrectly supplied we replace it or refund in full, no return required. Equipment may be returned unused within 30 days.
pages.shipping_policy: Roasting days are Monday and Thursday; orders ship the same day they are roasted. Standard delivery $4.50, free over $40, arriving in 2-3 business days.
pages.subscription_terms: Coffee subscriptions ship every 1, 2 or 4 weeks at a 10% discount. Change the coffee, pause or cancel from your account at any time before the next roast day. No minimum term.
